display.purpose: The page h1, one per screen. Archivo 680 at -0.018em and 1.06 line-height, so a title takes as little vertical room as it can while still leading.

headline.purpose: Section headings on marketing surfaces. Same engineered grotesque, one step down.

title.purpose: Card headings. Deliberately set in the body face at card scale, because a card title labels a region rather than opening a new voice.

body.purpose: Prose and table content. Hanken Grotesk at 1.6 to stay readable against the compressed headings.

label.purpose: Annotation only: eyebrows, employee codes, dates, times, figures. JetBrains Mono uppercase at 0.16em tracking. Never a sentence.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Every card, at rest. The tight first layer seats the edge; the wide offset second layer is the lift.

shadows.name: card-rest-dark
shadows.purpose: The same card in dark. Deepened because shadow reads as almost nothing against brand ink.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Modals, dropdowns and toasts — anything above the page rather than in it.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Input focus. A glow rather than an outline shift, so nothing reflows when a field is entered.

motion.name: dur-micro
motion.purpose: State changes on controls: button fill, border colour, chip tint.

motion.name: dur-ui
motion.purpose: Interface movement: the rail drawer, meter fills, dialog entrance.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing. A hard early settle — things arrive and stop rather than drifting.

motion.name: ease-inout
motion.purpose: Symmetric movement, used where something leaves the way it came.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action a screen wants. Fill changes on hover; nothing lifts.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: 0; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #0e7e90); color: var(--accent-ink, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong, #0c6b7a); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0e7e90); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The secondary action. A hairline border and a raised fill; it recedes beside the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; background: var(--raised, #fff); color: var(--fg, #0b1526); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #0b15263d); transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface, #edf2f7); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0e7e90); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The working surface. Hairline border plus a two-layer lift, so it reads as an object on the sheet.
components.html:
Leave balance

9.00 days available, accruing 1 per month.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--raised, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #0b15261a); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px #0b15260d, 0 10px 30px -8px #0b15261f; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #0b15261a); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.008em; color: var(--fg, #0b1526); } .ds-card-body { padding: 1.25rem; } .ds-card-copy { margin: 0; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted, #44566b); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label always present and associated. Focus glows rather than shifting the border, so nothing reflows.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-label { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg, #0b1526); } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #0b15263d); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--field-bg, #fff); color: var(--fg, #0b1526); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #0e7e90); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, #0e7e901a); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Six tones, and the label always carries the meaning. The tint only groups.
components.html: Approved Pending Rejected
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-ok { background: var(--ok-soft, #0e8a5f14); color: var(--ok, #0e8a5f); } .ds-badge-warn { background: var(--warn-soft, #b7791f14); color: var(--warn, #b7791f); } .ds-badge-err { background: var(--err-soft, #d6453d14); color: var(--err-text, #b93a32); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Rail navigation. The active item fills with the accent tint and turns teal. An item the user cannot use is absent, never disabled.
components.html: HomeAttendance
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.125rem; padding: 0.5rem; background: var(--raised, #fff); border-radius: 12px; } .ds-navlink { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 0.75rem; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted, #44566b); text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-navlink:hover { background: var(--surface, #edf2f7); color: var(--fg, #0b1526); } .ds-navlink-active { background: var(--accent-soft, #0e7e901a); color: var(--accent, #0e7e90); font-weight: 600; } .ds-navlink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0e7e90); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: The signature label, carried verbatim from validuresolutions.com. Mono, uppercase, 0.16em tracked, preceded by a 5px teal dot. It is what makes a screen recognisable at a glance.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; margin: 0; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--faint, #5b6e84); } .ds-eyebrow::before { content: ''; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent, #0e7e90); flex: none; }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: The dashboard counter. Mono uppercase label, oversized Archivo figure, muted meta line. Six of these form the attendance grid.
components.html:
Present

15

days this cycle
components.css: .ds-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 1.25rem; background: var(--raised, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #0b15261a); border-radius: 16px; } .ds-stat-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--faint, #5b6e84); } .ds-stat-val { margin: 0; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 680; letter-spacing: -0.018em; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--fg, #0b1526); } .ds-stat-meta { margin: 0; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--muted, #44566b); }

narrative.overview:
ValidureHR is drawn the way an engineer keeps a notebook: ruled, annotated, and exact. Hairlines do the work grid lines do on squared paper — they define every edge, separate every row, and are almost the only decoration the system allows. Labels are set in mono, uppercase and widely tracked, because they are annotations on the data rather than part of it. The teal accent is the pen that gets picked up for one thing at a time.

The density is deliberate and higher than a marketing site's. This is a product people work inside for a shift, often at night, frequently on a phone; screens carry tables of 24 rows and six-tile stat grids, and the rhythm is tuned for scanning rather than strolling. Headings are tight (680 weight, -0.018em, 1.06 line-height) so a title occupies as little vertical room as it can while still leading. Body copy is Hanken Grotesk at a generous 1.6 to stay readable against that compression.

Restraint is the house voice, but not flatness. Surfaces genuinely lift off the page — a card is an object resting on the sheet, not a region drawn on it — while the controls on those surfaces stay precise and do not move. The dark theme is derived from the brand ink rather than inverted from the light theme: #0b1526 is the text colour in light and becomes the page itself in dark, so the two themes are the same material seen at two exposures. A lightness-inverted dark logo was tried and rejected as washed out; that approach must not return.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline borders as the primary structural device
Mono uppercase labels as annotation, never as content
One accent, used sparingly and never decoratively
Dense, scannable data rhythm tuned for a working shift
Dark theme derived from the brand ink, not inverted

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: Validure Teal marks at most one thing per view — the primary action, or the active location, not both competing. If two elements are teal, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Text-Or-It-Didn't-Happen Rule
rules.body: No state is ever carried by colour alone. Every badge, calendar cell and status pill prints its meaning as words; the tint only groups them. A screenshot in greyscale must still be unambiguous.

rules.name: The Cyan Is Not A UI Colour Rule
rules.body: Filament Cyan belongs to the logo and to brand-scale moments. It never becomes a button, a link, a chip or a chart series.

rules.name: The Annotation Rule
rules.body: Mono is for things you look up, not things you read: codes, dates, times, amounts, durations. A sentence never gets set in mono.

rules.name: The One H1 Rule
rules.body: Every screen has exactly one h1, supplied by PageHead. Card titles are h2. Nothing skips a level to get a size.

rules.name: The 320 Rule
rules.body: Nothing overflows the viewport at 320px. Wide tables scroll inside .tablewrap; they never widen the page. Every grid and flex child carries min-width: 0, because the default of auto is what silently breaks this.

rules.name: The Objects-Lift-Controls-Don't Rule
rules.body: Cards, dialogs and popovers carry shadow. Buttons, inputs, chips and table rows never do — they change colour, and that is all.

rules.name: The Radius-Follows-Role Rule
rules.body: Radius communicates what a thing is, not how friendly it wants to look. If a new element needs a radius, decide whether it is inset (8), a control (12), or a surface (16) — do not pick by eye.

dos: Do use tokens for every colour — --fg, --muted, --accent, --ok, and the -soft variants. The dark theme works only because of this.
Do give every card a hairline border as well as its shadow.
Do print the meaning of every status as text beside its tint.
Do put wide tables in .tablewrap and give numeric columns .num on both the th and the td.
Do run money through money() and dates through fmtDate/fmtDay — never new Date('YYYY-MM-DD'), which shifts the day.
Do hide an action the user lacks permission for, rather than disabling it.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent. One pen.
Don't use Filament Cyan anywhere in the UI.
Don't put a shadow or a lift on a button, input, chip or table row.
Don't set a sentence in JetBrains Mono.
Don't add a raw hex, rgb() or named colour to a component — if a value is missing from the scale, add a token.
Don't reintroduce a lightness-inverted dark logo. It was tried and rejected as washed out.
Don't let a grid or flex child keep its default min-width: auto; it is what breaks 320px.
